description: Korean practice checklists for work next to licensed professions: business permit filings (restaurant/cafe, online retail, beauty), foreigner stay deadlines (registration 90 days, address change 15 days, extension window), public e-portals (Hometax, 4 social insurances/Work24, Internet Registry, e-Court, UNI-PASS, Patent-ro) and how to read professional documents (loss adjustment report, appraisal report, broker's confirmation statement, patent specification/claims, import declaration documents). Returns what to prepare, what to check (with statute citations), deadlines computed from given dates (first day excluded, holiday roll-over), official links and who may act as representative. Information only; no filing or drafting.
